channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Taj Gibson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Taj Gibson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Wiseman on Taj Gibson
item.description:
James Wiseman on Taj Gibson:

“He's given me a lot of confidence, always speaking to me, always telling me just play my game”

James Wiseman on Taj Gibson, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @TheNBACentral.

item.title: Monty Williams on Taj Gibson
item.description:
Monty Williams on Taj Gibson:

“Ijust like having another veteran guy around our team. We look at Evan and how he’s had an impact on the floor and in some other areas. Taj is an example of how you handle your business on the court, it can pay dividends in other areas.”

Monty Williams on Taj Gibson, Mar 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Taj Gibson, Larry Bird
item.description:
No. 22 Jimmy Butler:

“I played (in Chicago) with one of the toughest individuals I’ve ever played with in my life — Taj Gibson. He taught me so much about how to be a pro. Sometimes people choose numbers because of someone that inspires them, and Taj is one of those people. I wore 33 at Marquette. In high school, I wore No. 1 because of Tracy McGrady. My best friend, who’s a brother to me and (who) I moved in with, was No. 33. And as much as his family had done for me, I chose it because his mom’s favorite player was Larry Bird, and then it kind of stuck. It was all because of Larry Bird and Jordan Leslie.”

Jimmy Butler on Tracy McGrady, Taj Gibson, Larry Bird, Apr 11, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Taj Gibson, Jimmy Butler
item.description:
Noah says he and Rose still talk about how much they miss some of the good times they had with Thibodeau and their teammates in Chicago.

“I know I never would have gotten those awards [including Defensive Player of the Year in 2014] without Jimmy Butler, without Taj Gibson,”

Joakim Noah on Taj Gibson, Jimmy Butler, Oct 24, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Sam Presti on Taj Gibson
item.description:
Fred Katz:Presti on Gibson:

“He's one of those guys that you see for years and you go, I would like that guy to wear a Thunder jerseyat some point”

Sam Presti on Taj Gibson, May 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Taj Gibson
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Jimmy Butler on Taj Gibson:

“Taj was amazing to me all the years that I've been here. One thing you could count on Taj, he was coming in bright spirited every day. He isn't emotional as I am on a day to day basis. Any day that anybody walked in pissed off or sad or whatever it may be, all you got to do is look at Taj, man. Taj is always smiling. That's what we're going to miss. He did all the little things for us and played extremely hard. But I think the person that he was -- that's what's going to be missed. Basketball is basketball, that's forever going to be my guy from Fort Greene, Brooklyn.”

Jimmy Butler on Taj Gibson, Feb 24, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Sam Presti on Taj Gibson
item.description:
Erik Horne:Sam Presti on Taj Gibson:

“He's an excellent pick and roll defender and one of the most respected competitors in the league.”

Sam Presti on Taj Gibson, Feb 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Kevin Love on Taj Gibson
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Kevin Love on getting hit in his face by Taj Gibson's head:

“Without a mouthguard I probably would have knocked my two front teeth out”

Kevin Love on Taj Gibson, Jan 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson
item.description:
“We're not starting from scratch... We still have Noah and Derrick and (Mike) Dunleavy and Taj Gibson and (Carlos) Boozer.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson, Jan 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @stevekylerNBA.

item.title: LeBron James on Kirk Hinrich, Taj Gibson
item.description:
“I believe and I know that a lot of my fouls are not basketball plays. First of all, Kirk Hinrich in the first quarter basically grabbed me with two hands and brought me to the ground. The last one, Taj Gibson was able to collar me around my shoulder and bring me to the ground. Those are not defensive ... those are not basketball plays.”

LeBron James on Kirk Hinrich, Taj Gibson, Mar 28, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.
